keyEvents.text: Jake Batty (Fleetwood Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Fleetwood Town 0, Rochdale 1. Luke Hannant (Rochdale) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Charlie Tasker.
Harvey Gilmour (Rochdale) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Fleetwood Town 1, Rochdale 1. Ronan Coughlan (Fleetwood Town) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
